questions.question: What attack injects malicious scripts into web pages viewed by users?
questions.explanation: XSS exploits trust in user browsers.

questions.question: What attack manipulates database queries through user input?
What attack tricks users into executing unwanted actions?
What firewall specifically protects web applications?
questions.explanation: WAFs filter HTTP traffic to applications.

questions.question: What policy controls which domains can access resources?
What security policy restricts content sources?
questions.explanation: CSP prevents XSS and injection attacks.

questions.question: What standard secures payment card data?
alternatives: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

questions.question: What authentication token format contains claims in JSON?
questions.explanation: JWTs securely transmit information between parties.

questions.question: What attack intercepts communication between two parties?
Which cookie attribute blocks JavaScript from accessing the cookie?
Which cookie attribute restricts transmission to HTTPS connections?
questions.explanation: Secure cookies only travel encrypted channels.

questions.question: What random data strengthens each password hash uniquely?
questions.explanation: Salts prevent identical hashes for same passwords.

questions.question: What query method separates SQL code from user-supplied input?
What response header tells browsers which origins may read a resource?
questions.explanation: This header enforces CORS origin rules.
